name: dedup-merge-lineage-validation-reuse
title: Fix merge-lineage false positive forcing redundant DONE validation re-runs (reuse + admissibility copies via one shared classifier)
description: A main-merge makes git diff-tree -m re-list the story's own content-unchanged files as untrusted-lineage-path, so DONE validation reuse is refused (and autopilot_review_submit --deriveBindings hard-throws) despite identical materialHash/storyFilesHash/identity.digest, forcing a redundant ~17 min full-suite re-run. Replace the per-commit -m union with a hardened net endpoint diff in one shared classifier used by both copies.
